prompts.title: Dramatic Graphic Illustration of a Gentleman
prompts.prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 high-resolution black-and-white graphic-novel illustration with a bold red-and-black splash-art aesthetic. Show a man in a dramatic chest-up three-quarter pose, body turned slightly away while looking toward the viewer, framed from approximately the mid-chest upward. His expression should be serious, intense, calm, and confident, with a strong cinematic presence.
He is dressed in a sharp black formal suit jacket with realistic structured tailoring, subtle fabric folds, and deep black shadows. Under the jacket, include a crisp white dress shirt with an open collar, creating strong contrast against the dark suit. Emphasize the angular structure of the clothing using bold ink outlines, cross-hatching, stippling, and comic-book shadow work.
Use a high-contrast monochrome illustration technique for the entire subject: pure blacks, whites, and multiple shades of gray. Add detailed cross-hatched engraving lines, fine ink strokes, stippling, rough pencil textures, and graphic-novel shading throughout the face, clothing, and exposed areas. The lighting should be dramatic and directional, creating bright highlights on one side and deep black shadows on the opposite side.
The background should feature a large, abstract red paint-splash composition covering and extending behind the subject. Surround it with numerous black and red ink splatters, droplets, irregular brush marks, scattered particles, and explosive paint strokes. Keep portions of the background clean white to create strong contrast and make the red and black elements stand out dramatically.
The overall composition should feel like a premium comic-book character poster / graphic novel cover, with a gritty hand-inked appearance, dynamic contrast, strong silhouette, editorial poster composition, and cinematic intensity.
Style: ultra-detailed black-and-white graphic novel, hand-inked comic illustration, realistic proportions, engraved illustration, cross-hatching, stippling, rough ink texture, high contrast, dramatic lighting, bold contour lines, red-and-black poster aesthetic, sophisticated editorial artwork.
Composition: vertical 4:5, centered subject, three-quarter view, chest-up portrait, subject occupying most of the frame, clean silhouette, strong visual hierarchy, red paint splash behind the subject.
Color palette: monochrome black, white, and grayscale for the character, with vivid deep crimson red used exclusively for the background paint splashes and selected splatter accents.
Quality: highly detailed, sharp inkwork, crisp edges, intricate textures, professional comic-book illustration, 8K quality, poster-ready, no text, no logo, no watermark.

prompts.title: Manga Muse
prompts.prompt:
Core Concept
A striking mixed-media composition featuring a high-resolution photograph of a woman standing in front of a large, wall-sized black-and-white manga collage. The image explores the "multiverse" or "multifaceted" nature of the subject’s personality.

Central Figure (Photographic)
Subject: woman with a modern hairstyle, round glasses, and a face identical to the reference image. She occupies approximately 60–70% of the frame height, perfectly centered
Expression: She has a genuine and confident smile.
Attire: A classic blue denim jacket over a simple black t-shirt, tucked into high-waisted blue jeans. She is wearing elegant black pointed-toe high heels.
Pose: She stands in the center foreground, hands casually in her pockets, with her legs crossed at the ankles.
Lighting: Bright, professional studio lighting that makes her pop against the background.
Background (Manga Style)
Art Style: Classic Japanese manga aesthetics—bold ink lines, screentone textures (dots), and dramatic speed lines.
Narrative Panels: The background consists of various panels featuring the same woman as a manga character in different scenarios:
Top Left: Riding a motorcycle with speed lines and the text "VROOM."
Top Right: Looking focused and intense while working at a computer desk.
Middle: Walking through a bustling city street.
Bottom Left: Using a smartphone on a gimbal, as if vlogging or taking a selfie.
Bottom Right: Laughing and embracing two friends, with a "KYA!" speech bubble nearby.
Text Elements: Integrated Japanese onomatopoeia (e.g., "ドキドキ" for a racing heart) and English sound effects scattered throughout the panels.
Composition & Mood
Contrast: A sharp contrast between the vibrant, 3D realism of the woman in the foreground and the flat, 2D, monochromatic world of the white comic book background.
Vibe: Empowered, joyful, and modern. It suggests a life full of adventure, hard work, and meaningful social connections.
Floor color white.
Aspect ratio 2:3
